definition_en: A bearing in which a thin film of pressurized air separates the moving element from its guide surface, giving frictionless, wear-free motion with very low vibration. Wafer and reticle stages and precision spindles use it, often with vacuum preload, where mechanical bearings would add friction, particles or hysteresis.
variants_ja: 空気軸受;静圧空気軸受;エア軸受;エアーベアリング
ng_ja: 空気ベアリング
ng_note: 「空気ベアリング」は和洋混合で現場では使わない（エアベアリング／空気軸受）。スペイン語「rodamiento」は転動体のある軸受を指し、空気軸受には不適。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: A. H. Slocum, Precision Machine Design (Prentice Hall, 1992)

definition_en: A thin-film deposition method in which two or more precursor gases are pulsed alternately into the chamber, each reacting with the surface in a self-limiting way so that film grows roughly one atomic layer per cycle. It gives precise thickness control and conformal coverage in high-aspect-ratio structures.
variants_ja: ALD;原子層成膜;アトミックレイヤーデポジション
ng_ja: 原子層蒸着;原子層沈着;原子層付着
ng_note: deposition を「沈着/沉淀/Ablagerung/sedimentación」(沈殿・堆積物)と訳すのは誤り。日 蒸着 は蒸発法(PVD)を指す語で ALD には不適。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: S. M. George, Atomic Layer Deposition: An Overview, Chem. Rev. 110, 111 (2010); SEMI International Standards: Compilation of Terms

definition_en: The fab-wide system of overhead transport vehicles, stockers, conveyors and control software that moves wafer carriers between tools and storage without manual handling. It covers both interbay and intrabay transport.
variants_ja: AMHS;自動マテリアルハンドリングシステム
ng_ja: 自動材料処理システム;自動材料取扱システム
term_es: sistema automatizado de manejo de materiales
ng_note: 「材料処理／材料处理」は material handling の直訳で、化学処理と誤解される。現場では「搬送」で通じる。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI E153 — Specification for AMHS SEM (AMHS SEM)

definition_en: Measuring the ion beam current, usually with a Faraday cup in the beamline or end station, to integrate charge and control implanted dose. Secondary-electron suppression and neutral-beam compensation are needed so that the reading equals the true ion current reaching the wafer.
variants_ja: ビーム電流計測;ビームカレント測定;ビーム電流モニタ
ng_ja: 光線電流測定;ビーム電流量測定
term_es: medición de la corriente del haz
ng_note: beam を「光線」「光束」「광선」と訳すのは光学の誤訳。イオン注入では「ビーム電流／束流」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: S. Wolf and R. N. Tauber, Silicon Processing for the VLSI Era, Vol. 1: Process Technology, 2nd ed., Lattice Press (2000)

definition_en: Penetration of implanted ions far deeper than expected when the beam is aligned with a low-index crystal direction and ions travel between atomic rows with few collisions. Implanters tilt and twist the wafer, or use a screen oxide, to randomize incidence and keep the junction depth predictable.
variants_ja: チャンネリング;イオンチャネリング
ng_ja: 溝加工;水路化;経路形成
ng_note: 「溝加工」「水路化」「Kanalisierung」は機械加工・土木の channeling。注入では結晶軸に沿う深い侵入現象を指す。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: S. Wolf and R. N. Tauber, Silicon Processing for the VLSI Era, Vol. 1: Process Technology, 2nd ed., Lattice Press (2000)

definition_en: Growth of a solid film on a heated substrate from gaseous precursors that react or decompose at or near the surface, with by-products carried away by the exhaust. Thermal, plasma-enhanced and low-pressure variants are used for dielectrics, polysilicon and metals.
variants_ja: CVD;化学蒸着;化学気相堆積;化学的気相成長
ng_ja: 化学蒸気堆積;化学的蒸気析出
ng_note: vapor を水蒸気の「蒸気/蒸汽/Dampf」と訳すと誤り。気相(gas phase)からの成膜。西 vapor químico は語順で意味が変わる。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI M59 — Terminology for Silicon Technology; H. O. Pierson, Handbook of Chemical Vapor Deposition, 2nd ed. (Noyes, 1999)

definition_en: The angle between the surface of a liquid droplet and the solid surface it rests on, measured through the liquid. On wafers it quantifies how hydrophilic or hydrophobic a surface is after cleaning and predicts watermark and drying behavior.
variants_ja: 濡れ角;水接触角;コンタクトアングル
ng_ja: 接点角;触角
ng_note: 「触角」は昆虫の触角、「接点角」は電気接点を連想させる誤訳。独は Kontaktwinkel と Randwinkel が併存。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: ISO 19403-2 — Paints and varnishes — Wettability — Part 2: Determination of the surface free energy of solid surfaces by measuring the contact angle; K. A. Reinhardt & W. Kern (eds.), Handbook of Silicon Wafer Cleaning Technology, 3rd ed. (William Andrew, 2018)

definition_en: Unintended transfer of chemical species, particles or metallic impurities from one wafer, bath or chamber to another, for example when wafers from different process steps share a cleaning bath. Tool dedication and recipe segregation are used to prevent it.
term_ja: クロスコンタミネーション
variants_ja: クロスコンタミ;相互汚染;交差汚染
ng_ja: 二次汚染
ng_note: 日本語の半導体現場では「クロスコンタミ」が定着。「交差汚染」は食品・医薬分野の訳語、「二次汚染」は別概念。 「交差汚染」はJIS Z 8122 1082に用例あり → variants へ。「二次汚染」は用例なし（別概念）
source_ref: W. Kern (ed.), Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology (Noyes, 1993); K. A. Reinhardt & W. Kern (eds.), Handbook of Silicon Wafer Cleaning Technology, 3rd ed. (William Andrew, 2018)

definition_en: The crystallographic direction of a single-crystal wafer surface normal, such as (100) or (111), together with the azimuthal reference given by the notch or flat. It determines etch behaviour, oxidation rate, carrier mobility and cleavage, and is checked by X-ray or optical methods.
variants_ja: 面方位;結晶面方位;結晶軸方位;ウェハ方位
ng_ja: 結晶方向;結晶配向;結晶の向き;水晶方位
ng_zh: 水晶方向;晶体朝向;结晶方位
ng_es: dirección del cristal;orientación de cuarzo;alineación cristalina
ng_note: crystal を「水晶/수정/Quarz/cuarzo」（石英）と訳す機械翻訳誤りが典型。JA「結晶配向」は多結晶膜の配向（テクスチャ）の語で単結晶ウェハの方位には使わない。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI MF26 — Test Method for Determining the Orientation of a Semiconductive Single Crystal

definition_en: A plot of the positions of detected defects across a wafer, generated by an inspection tool, with each defect classified by size or type. Engineers compare maps across process steps to find where defects were added and to recognize signatures such as scratches or arc patterns.
variants_ja: ディフェクトマップ;欠陥分布図;ウェハマップ
ng_ja: 欠陥地図
ng_note: 「地図」「Landkarte」は地理の map。中国語「瑕疵」は外観傷の語で工程欠陥には「缺陷」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI M35 — Guide for Developing Specifications for Silicon Wafer Surface Features Detected by Automated Inspection

definition_en: Recess of a soft or fast-polishing feature, such as a copper line or pad, below the surrounding harder surface after CMP, leaving a shallow dish-shaped depression. It is measured together with erosion to characterize planarization quality.
variants_ja: ディシング
ng_ja: 皿状化;皿盛り;凹み
ng_note: dishing は英語借用が定着。「皿状」「Schüssel」等の直訳は通じず、「凹み」は一般語で不特定。中 蝶形 は 碟形 の誤字。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: J. M. Steigerwald, S. P. Murarka & R. J. Gutmann, Chemical Mechanical Planarization of Microelectronic Materials (Wiley, 1997)

definition_en: The second stage of a two-step diffusion in which a wafer that already carries a shallow predeposited dopant layer is heated, usually in an oxidising or inert ambient, so that the dopant redistributes deeper into the silicon to the target junction depth. It sets the final profile without adding more dopant.
variants_ja: ドライブイン拡散;押し込み拡散;追い込み拡散;再分布拡散
ng_ja: 乗り入れ;運転投入;ドライブ・イン方式
ng_note: drive-in を自動車関連（乗り入れ/驾入/Einfahrt/autocine）と訳す機械翻訳誤りが実在する。拡散工程の後段を指す。 見出し語自体の用例が未確認のためNG訳も据え置き（公開資料に用例なし）
source_ref: J. D. Plummer, M. D. Deal & P. B. Griffin, Silicon VLSI Technology: Fundamentals, Practice and Modeling (Prentice Hall, 2000)

definition_en: Measurement of electrical parameters on test structures or devices on a wafer to confirm that the process has produced the intended transistor and interconnect characteristics. In a fab it is run on wafers at defined points of the flow, often at the end, to accept or reject lots.
variants_ja: 電気テスト;E-test;電気特性評価;電気特性検査;ウェハ電気試験
ng_ja: 耐電圧試験;電気安全試験;電力試験
ng_zh: 电力测试;电气安全测试
ng_es: prueba de potencia;prueba de seguridad eléctrica
ng_note: 「耐電圧試験/電気安全試験」は装置や製品の安全規格試験であり、ウェハの特性評価とは別概念。powerの誤読による「電力試験」は不可。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: G. S. May & C. J. Spanos, Fundamentals of Semiconductor Manufacturing and Process Control (Wiley, 2006)

definition_en: A hard-wired button and circuit that removes hazardous power from a tool at once, independently of the control software. It is the last-resort cut-off defined for cluster tools and fab equipment, distinct from a controlled emergency stop.
variants_ja: 緊急遮断;EMO回路;EMOボタン;非常遮断
ng_ja: 非常停止
ng_note: 「非常停止／紧急停止／비상정지／Not-Halt／parada de emergencia」は制御系で機械を止める emergency stop（E-stop）を指し、電源を遮断する EMO とは SEMI S2 で区別される。 非常停止は同JISで emergency stop device（3.21）として別概念。EMOの訳としてはNG
source_ref: SEMI E20 — Cluster Tool Module Interface: Electrical Power and Emergency Off Standard; SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health, and Safety Guideline for Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment

definition_en: Drawing ions out of the ion source plasma through a slit and forming them into a beam with electrodes held at high potential relative to the source. The extraction voltage and electrode geometry set the initial beam energy and the current an implanter can deliver.
variants_ja: イオン引き出し;ビーム引き出し;引出し
ng_ja: 抽出;摘出;取り出し
ng_note: 「抽出」「提取」「추출」は化学分離やデータ抽出の語。イオン源からは「引き出す」（引き出し電極）が慣用。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: S. Wolf and R. N. Tauber, Silicon Processing for the VLSI Era, Vol. 1: Process Technology, 2nd ed., Lattice Press (2000); J. F. Ziegler (ed.), Ion Implantation: Science and Technology, 2nd ed., Academic Press (1988)

definition_en: Continuous sensing of hazardous gas concentration at points such as gas cabinets, valve manifold boxes and tool enclosures, with alarms and interlocks that cut off supply when a leak is found. It is a core requirement of equipment safety design for toxic, flammable and corrosive gases.
variants_ja: ガス検出;ガスモニタリング;漏洩ガス検知
ng_ja: ガス探査;ガス発見
ng_note: 「探査」「発見」「发现」は detection の一般訳。安全設備では「ガス検知（器）」「气体检测」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health, and Safety Guideline for Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment

definition_en: A liquid chemical refined to semiconductor-grade limits on metallic, particulate and anionic contamination, used for wafer cleaning, etching and resist processing. Its purity grade sets the materials and cleanliness required of the delivery and dispense system.
variants_ja: 高純度化学薬品;高純度ケミカル;電子工業用薬品
ng_ja: 高純度化学物質;高純度薬剤
ng_note: 「化学物質」は化審法など法令の語、「薬剤」は医薬のニュアンス。半導体では「薬品／ケミカル」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI C1 — Guide for the Analysis of Liquid Chemicals; SEMI F57 — Specification for High Purity Polymer Materials and Components Used in Ultrapure Water and Liquid Chemical Distribution Systems

definition_en: A reliability stress test in which packaged devices are operated under bias at elevated ambient temperature for an extended time, typically 1000 hours, to accelerate wear-out and infant mortality failure mechanisms. Results are used to project field lifetime.
variants_ja: HTOL試験;高温動作試験;高温動作寿命;高温通電寿命試験
ng_ja: 高温運転寿命;高温操作寿命;高温作動生活
ng_zh: 高温运行寿命;高温操作寿命;高温经营寿命
ng_ko: 고온 운전 수명;고온 작업 생활;고온 조작 수명
term_es: prueba de vida operativa a alta temperatura
ng_es: vida de operación de alta temperatura;prueba de vida de funcionamiento caliente
ng_note: life を「生活/生活/Leben」、operating を「運転/操作/経営」と訳すのは機械翻訳の典型誤り。信頼性分野の定訳は「動作寿命」。 見出し語自体の用例が未確認のためNG訳も据え置き（公開資料に用例なし）
source_ref: JEDEC JESD22-A108 — Temperature, Bias, and Operating Life

definition_en: The number of particles in a slurry above a size threshold, typically around 0.5 to 1 micrometer, that is far larger than the mean abrasive size, measured by single-particle optical sensing. It is tracked because these oversized particles correlate with scratch defects.
variants_ja: LPC;ラージパーティクルカウント;大粒子カウント
ng_ja: 大規模粒子数;大量粒子数
ng_note: large は粒径が大きいことで「大量」「大規模」ではない。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI C98 — Guide for Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Particle Size Distribution (PSD) Measurement and Reporting Used in Semiconductor Manufacturing

definition_en: The electrode in a parallel-plate plasma chamber on which the wafer rests, usually integrated with the electrostatic chuck and temperature control. In RIE tools it carries the RF bias that accelerates ions toward the wafer.
variants_ja: 下電極;ボトム電極;サセプタ電極
ng_ja: 低電極;下方電極
ng_note: lower は位置（下部）であり「低い」ではない。各言語で「低電極」系は誤訳。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: K. Nojiri, Dry Etching Technology for Semiconductors, Springer (2015); M. A. Lieberman and A. J. Lichtenberg, Principles of Plasma Discharges and Materials Processing, 2nd ed., Wiley (2005)

definition_en: A tunable reactive circuit placed between an RF generator and a plasma load so that the load impedance seen by the generator stays at 50 ohm and reflected power is minimised. In production tools it is an automatically tuned unit mounted close to the chamber electrode.
variants_ja: 整合器;自動整合器;マッチャー;インピーダンス整合器;マッチングユニット;マッチングネットワーク;整合回路
ng_ja: 整合ネットワーク;一致回路;適合回路;マッチング網;インピーダンス適合ネットワーク;インピーダンス適合回路;抵抗マッチング
ng_zh: 配对网络;一致网络;匹配网路;阻抗适配网络
ng_ko: 일치 네트워크;정합 망;매칭 회로망;임피던스 적합 회로
ng_es: red de coincidencia;red de emparejamiento;red de ajuste;red de emparejamiento de impedancia
ng_note: matching を「一致/適合/coincidencia/Übereinstimmung」と訳すのは誤り（インピーダンス整合）。「整合ネットワーク/網」は直訳で現場では「マッチングボックス/整合器/マッチャー」。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳） / matching を「適合」「适配」「emparejamiento」と訳すのは誤り。電気では「整合／匹配／adaptación」。impedance を「抵抗」とするのも不正確。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI E113 — Specification for Semiconductor Processing Equipment RF Power Delivery Systems

definition_en: The average time an excess electron or hole survives in a semiconductor before recombining, which reflects the density of recombination centers such as metallic contamination. It is measured contactlessly on wafers, for example by photoconductance decay or microwave reflection, to monitor cleanliness of furnaces and wet benches.
term_ja: 少数キャリアライフタイム
variants_ja: 少数キャリア寿命;キャリアライフタイム;ライフタイム
ng_ja: 少数キャリア生存時間;マイノリティキャリア寿命
term_es: tiempo de vida de portadores minoritarios
ng_note: 「生存時間」は直訳。中国語「载体」・韓国語「운송자」・スペイン語「transportador」は運搬の carrier で、電荷担体は「载流子」「운반자／캐리어」「portador」。独「Minderheit」は社会的少数派。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI MF28 — Test Method for Minority Carrier Lifetime in Bulk Germanium and Silicon by Measurement of Photoconductivity Decay

definition_en: A pattern placed off its intended position relative to an earlier layer because the exposure tool's alignment to the wafer marks was wrong or the marks were damaged. It appears as a systematic overlay error and can cause shorts or opens where layers must connect.
variants_ja: アライメントずれ;位置ずれ;ミスアライメント;重ね合わせずれ
ng_ja: 不整列;誤整合;整合不良
ng_note: 「不整列」「誤整合」は辞書訳。現場では「合わせずれ／アライメントずれ」。中国語「不对齐」は一般語で装置文脈では「对准偏差」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI P35 — Terminology for Microlithography Metrology

definition_en: The spontaneous release of gas, mainly water vapour and solvents, from the surfaces and bulk of materials inside a vacuum system after pump-down. It sets the ultimate pressure and pump-down time of a chamber and drives the choice of materials, bake-out and purge practice.
variants_ja: アウトガッシング;脱ガス;ガス放出;気体放出;アウトガス放出
ng_ja: 排ガス;ガス抜き;出ガス;ガス漏れ
ng_es: escape de gases;gases de escape;fuga de gas;ventilación
ng_note: 「排ガス/排气/배기/Abgas/gases de escape」は排気系から出るガスで別概念。「ガス抜き/除气/Entgasung」は意図的な脱気処理を指し、現象名としては不可。「ガス漏れ/漏气/fuga」はリーク。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: ISO 3529-1 — Vacuum technology — Vocabulary — Part 1: General terms

definition_en: The RF power an RF generator delivers at its output connector, normally stated as forward power into a matched 50 ohm load. It is the quantity that the generator setpoint, readback and SEMI E136 test method refer to.
variants_ja: 出力パワー;RF出力;出力
ng_ja: 出力動力;出力電源;出力エネルギー
ng_zh: 输出电源;输出动力;输出能量
ng_es: poder de salida;energía de salida;fuerza de salida
ng_note: power を「動力/電源/エネルギー/poder/Kraft」と訳すのは物理量の誤り。電力（W）を指す。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI E136 — Test Method for Determining the Output Power of RF Generators Used in Semiconductor Processing Equipment RF Power Delivery Systems

definition_en: The positional offset between a pattern printed in the current layer and the pattern of a reference layer, measured at overlay marks and reported as x and y vectors across the wafer. It is budgeted per layer pair and corrected through exposure-tool alignment corrections.
variants_ja: 重ね合わせ誤差;重ね合わせずれ;オーバーレイエラー;合わせずれ
ng_ja: 重複誤差;覆い誤差;上塗り誤差
ng_note: overlay を「重複」「覆い」「覆盖」「重叠」と訳すのは一般語の直訳。リソでは「重ね合わせ／オーバーレイ／套刻」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI P35 — Terminology for Microlithography Metrology; SEMI P28 — Specification for Overlay-Metrology Test Patterns for Integrated-Circuit Manufacture

definition_en: A planar crystal defect that nucleates at surface or near-surface damage and grows during thermal oxidation of a silicon wafer, visible after preferential etching as a short line defect. Its density is used as a wafer quality and process cleanliness indicator.
variants_ja: OSF;酸化誘起スタッキングフォルト;酸化誘起積層欠陥（OSF）
ng_ja: 酸化誘導積層欠陥;酸化誘発積み重ね欠陥;積層故障
ng_zh: 氧化诱发堆叠故障;氧化引起的堆垛错误;氧化堆积故障
ng_ko: 산화 유도 적층 고장;산화 적층 오류
term_es: falla de apilamiento inducida por oxidación
ng_es: avería de apilamiento;fallo de apilado por oxidación;error de apilamiento
ng_note: fault を「故障/고장/avería」と訳すのは誤り（結晶欠陥）。JAの定訳は「誘起」で、「誘導」は電磁誘導の語。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI MF1727 — Practice for Detection of Oxidation Induced Defects in Polished Silicon Wafers

definition_en: The resistance of a CMP polishing pad to indentation, usually reported on the Shore D or Shore A scale. Harder pads planarize better and softer pads reduce scratching, so it is a key consumable specification.
variants_ja: 研磨パッド硬度;パッド硬さ
ng_ja: パッド剛性;パッド強度
ng_note: 硬度(hardness)と剛性(stiffness)・強度(strength)は別の物性値。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI C100 — Guide for Reporting Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Polishing Pads Hardness Used in Semiconductor Manufacturing

definition_en: A discrete piece of solid or liquid matter on a wafer surface or in a gas, liquid or air stream, small enough to be counted individually and large enough to cause a defect. Equipment is specified by the number of particles it adds to a wafer.
variants_ja: 粒子;微粒子;異物
ng_ja: 粒;ほこり;粒子状物質
ng_note: 「ほこり/灰尘/Staub/polvo」は粗大な塵の意で、計数対象の微粒子汚染であるパーティクルとは区別する。「粒子状物質」は環境分野の用語。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI M59 — Terminology for Silicon Technology; SEMI M35 — Guide for Developing Specifications for Silicon Wafer Surface Features Detected by Automated Inspection; ISO 14644-1 — Cleanrooms and associated controlled environments — Part 1: Classification of air cleanliness by particle concentration

definition_en: The number of airborne particles at or above a given size per unit volume of air, the quantity by which cleanroom air cleanliness classes are defined. It is measured with a discrete particle counter at specified sampling locations.
variants_ja: パーティクル濃度;浮遊微粒子濃度;粒子数濃度;浮遊粒子数濃度
ng_ja: 粒子集中;粒子密度
ng_note: concentration を「集中」と訳すのは誤り。「密度」は質量/体積と混同されるので避ける。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: ISO 14644-1 — Cleanrooms and associated controlled environments — Part 1: Classification of air cleanliness by particle concentration

definition_en: A defect caused by a foreign particle that lands on the wafer during deposition or another process step and is then buried in or shadows the growing film, leaving a bump, pinhole or void in the pattern. Inspection systems classify it separately from pattern and process-induced defects.
variants_ja: 異物欠陥;粒子欠陥
ng_ja: 粒子欠点;微粒子不良
ng_note: defect を「欠点/缺点/결점」(短所)と訳すのは誤り。「不良」は製品判定の語で欠陥そのものではない。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI International Standards: Compilation of Terms

definition_en: Toppling or sticking together of adjacent high-aspect-ratio resist lines, driven by capillary forces as the rinse liquid dries after development. It limits how narrow and tall resist features can be printed and is countered with surfactant rinses or low-surface-tension drying.
variants_ja: パターンコラプス;レジスト倒れ;パターン崩れ
ng_ja: パターン崩壊
ng_note: 「崩壊」は collapse の直訳で現場では「倒れ」と言う。中国語「模式」・韓国語「무늬」・独「Muster」はソフトウェア/模様の意味の pattern で誤り。 パターン崩壊はE1〜E3資料に用例なし（商用用語サイトのみ）→ NG維持
source_ref: C. A. Mack, Fundamental Principles of Optical Lithography (Wiley, 2007)

definition_en: Clothing and devices worn by a worker, such as chemical-resistant gloves, goggles, face shields and respirators, to protect against hazards that remain after engineering controls. Equipment safety documents state what is required for each maintenance task.
variants_ja: 個人防護具;PPE
ng_ja: 個人保護装置;個人的防護装備
ng_note: 「装置/設備/Einrichtung」は機械側の防護設備を連想させ、身に着ける保護具とは区別する。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI S21 — Safety Guideline for Worker Protection

definition_en: Resist material left on the wafer after stripping or ashing, often as a hardened crust or thin scum produced by etch or implant exposure. It is removed by additional plasma or wet clean steps because it causes defects and blocks later processing.
variants_ja: レジスト残り;フォトレジスト残渣;残渣
ng_ja: 感光剤残留物;フォトレジスト残り物
ng_note: 「感光剤」「残留物」は辞書訳で、現場では「レジスト残渣（ざんさ）」。中国語も「感光剂」ではなく「光刻胶」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: S. Wolf and R. N. Tauber, Silicon Processing for the VLSI Era, Vol. 1: Process Technology, 2nd ed., Lattice Press (2000)

definition_en: A tiny hole through a thin film or resist layer, caused by a particle, bubble or local non-wetting, that exposes the layer beneath. Pinholes in dielectrics cause leakage or shorts and in resist lead to unwanted etching, so films are screened for pinhole density.
variants_ja: 微小孔;ピンホール欠陥
ng_ja: 針穴;ピン穴
ng_note: 「針穴」「바늘 구멍」「Stecknadelloch」は辞書直訳。膜の微小貫通孔は各言語とも音訳または「针孔」「poro」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI M59 — Terminology for Silicon Technology

definition_en: Removal of photoresist by exposing the wafer to an oxygen-based plasma that oxidizes the organic film into volatile gases. It is performed in a dedicated asher or in the etch chamber as a dry alternative to wet stripping.
variants_ja: プラズマアッシング;レジストアッシング;ドライ剥離
ng_ja: プラズマ灰化処理;焼却
ng_note: 「灰化」は分析化学の試料前処理の語で、装置現場では「アッシング」。「焼却」「incineración」は廃棄物処理の語。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: S. Wolf and R. N. Tauber, Silicon Processing for the VLSI Era, Vol. 1: Process Technology, 2nd ed., Lattice Press (2000); K. Nojiri, Dry Etching Technology for Semiconductors, Springer (2015)

definition_en: The scheduled interval, in time, wafer count or RF hours, between successive preventive maintenance events on a tool or module. Extending it without raising unscheduled downtime is a common equipment-engineering goal, since PM time counts against availability.
variants_ja: PMサイクル;定期メンテナンス周期;PM間隔;予防保全間隔
ng_ja: 予防保全循環
ng_note: 「循環」「순환」「Kreislauf」「círculo」は cycle を循環と直訳したもの。保全の間隔は「周期」「Intervall」「ciclo」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI E10 — Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM) and Utilization

definition_en: A single-crystal wafer whose front surface, and often back surface, has been chemically-mechanically polished to a mirror finish after slicing, lapping and etching, ready for device fabrication or epitaxy. It is the standard starting substrate specified by SEMI M1.
variants_ja: 鏡面ウェハ;ポリッシュドウェハ;ポリッシュトウェハ;鏡面研磨ウェハ;研磨ウェハ;PW;ポリッシュウェハ
ng_ja: 磨かれたウェハ;光沢ウェハ;研削ウェハ;洗練されたウェハ
ng_zh: 打磨晶圆;磨光片;光亮片;研磨片
ng_note: polished を「洗練された/세련된/raffiniert/refinada」と訳す機械翻訳誤りがある。「研削/研磨片/geschliffen/esmerilada」はグラインド工程の語で鏡面研磨とは別。「光沢/光亮/광택」は外観語で工程名ではない。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI M1 — Specification for Polished Single Crystal Silicon Wafers

definition_en: The maximum deviation between the commanded and the actually reached position of a motion axis over its travel, normally stated together with repeatability. Equipment specifications quote it for stages, robots and aligners to show how closely a target coordinate can be hit.
variants_ja: 位置決め確度;位置精度
ng_ja: 配置精度;ポジショニング正確さ
ng_note: 「配置精度」「放置精度」「배치 정밀도」「Platzierung」「colocación」は部品配置（placement）の語。軸の位置決めは「位置決め精度」。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: ISO 230-2 — Test code for machine tools — Part 2: Determination of accuracy and repeatability of positioning of numerically controlled axes

definition_en: The target RF power value commanded to a generator by the tool controller or recipe, against which the generator regulates its actual output. Readback and alarms are judged relative to it.
variants_ja: パワー設定値;出力設定値;パワーセットポイント;RF設定値
ng_ja: 電力設定点;パワー設定ポイント;電源設定値
ng_zh: 电源设定值;功率设置点;动力设定值
ng_es: punto fijo de potencia;punto de potencia;consigna de poder
ng_note: setpoint を「設定点/设置点/設定ポイント」と直訳するのは制御用語として不自然で、現場は「設定値/セットポイント」。「電源設定値」は電源装置の設定と誤解される。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI E113 — Specification for Semiconductor Processing Equipment RF Power Delivery Systems

definition_en: The difference in static air pressure between two adjacent spaces, such as a cleanroom and its corridor or a minienvironment and the surrounding bay, maintained so that air leaks from the cleaner to the less clean side. It is monitored as a basic contamination-control parameter.
variants_ja: 室間差圧;圧力差
ng_ja: 圧力差分;示差圧力
ng_note: differential を微分と訳した「压力微分」「압력 미분」は誤り。現場語は「差圧」。 確認した公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: ISO 14644-4 — Cleanrooms and associated controlled environments — Part 4: Design, construction and start-up; ISO 14644-3 — Cleanrooms and associated controlled environments — Part 3: Test methods

definition_en: Inert gas, usually nitrogen or argon, flowed through lines, chambers or enclosures to displace air, moisture or residual process gas before and after operation. It keeps high-purity gas lines clean and dilutes hazardous residues during maintenance.
variants_ja: パージ用ガス;N2パージ
ng_ja: 掃気ガス;洗浄ガス
ng_note: 「掃気」はボイラ・内燃機関の語。「洗浄ガス」「清洗气体」「Reinigungsgas」はクリーニングガス（NF3 等）と誤解される。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: SEMI E49.8 — Guide for High Purity Gas Distribution Systems

definition_en: A small quadrupole mass spectrometer mounted on a vacuum chamber to identify the gas species present and their partial pressures, used for leak checking, contamination and water-vapour monitoring and process endpoint. It operates only at high vacuum, so a differentially pumped inlet is used on process chambers.
variants_ja: 残留ガス分析装置;RGA;四重極質量分析計;四極子形質量分析計;Qマス;残留ガス分析器
ng_ja: 残余ガス分析器;残りガス分析装置;残留気体解析器
ng_zh: 剩余气体分析器;残留气体解析仪;余气分析仪
ng_ko: 잔여 가스 분석기;나머지 가스 분석기;잔류 가스 해석기
ng_es: analizador de gas remanente;analizador de gases restantes
ng_note: residual を「残余/剩余/残り/나머지/Rückstand/remanente」と訳すのは辞書訳で、真空分野の定訳は「残留」。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: ISO 14291:2012 — Vacuum gauges — Definitions and specifications for quadrupole mass spectrometers

definition_en: An advanced process control method that adjusts recipe setpoints between successive runs or lots using metrology results from earlier runs. It compensates slow drifts such as consumable wear without changing settings inside a run.
variants_ja: Run-to-Run制御;Run-to-Run(R2R)制御;ラン・ツー・ラン制御;ロット間制御
ng_ja: 連続運転制御;実行間制御
ng_note: ここでの run は「処理1回（ロット／ウェハ）」であり、「連続運転」「実行」と訳すと意味がずれる。ドイツ語は Steuerung（開ループ）ではなく Regelung（フィードバック）。 公開資料に用例なし。実行間制御は学術DB（J-GLOBAL）の論文題目訳のみで業界資料に用例なし
source_ref: SEMI E133 — Specification for Automated Process Control Systems Interface

definition_en: An electric motor combined with a position or speed feedback device and a drive that closes the control loop so the shaft follows commanded position, velocity and torque profiles. Equipment axes such as robot arms, stages and lifts use it where precise, repeatable motion is required.
variants_ja: サーボモーター;ACサーボモータ;サーボ
ng_ja: 従動モータ;追従モータ
ng_note: 「従動モータ」「追従モータ」のような訳語は使われず、カタカナで定着。中国語「服务」・スペイン語「servicio」は servo を service と誤読したもの。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: NEMA ICS 16 — Industrial Control and Systems: Motion/Position Control Motors, Controls, and Feedback Devices

definition_en: A test that dips package leads or terminations into molten solder after accelerated aging and inspects the wetted area to confirm that the surface finish will solder reliably at board assembly. JEDEC JESD22-B102 specifies the procedure for IC packages.
variants_ja: はんだ付け性試験方法;はんだ濡れ性試験;ソルダビリティ試験
ng_ja: 溶接性試験
ng_note: 「溶接／焊接／용접／Schweißen」は welding で、soldering（はんだ付け）とは別工程。 公開資料に用例なし。はんだ付けは溶接ではない
source_ref: JEDEC JESD22-B102 — Solderability

definition_en: A package that integrates several dies and often passive components, stacked or placed side by side on a substrate, so that the package itself delivers a complete functional system. It contrasts with a system on chip, where all functions sit on one die.
variants_ja: システムインパッケージ
ng_ja: パッケージ内システム;一体化パッケージ
ng_note: 「パッケージ内システム／封装内系统」は直訳で、業界では SiP／系统级封装で通じる。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: IEEE EPS Heterogeneous Integration Roadmap (2021 ed.), Chapter 21: SiP and Module System Integration

definition_en: The automatic test equipment that applies stimulus to a device under test and measures its response according to a test program, deciding pass, fail and bin. In a test cell it is coupled to a prober or a handler that presents the devices.
variants_ja: テスター;ATE;自動試験装置;試験装置;テスト装置;LSIテスタ
ng_ja: 試験者;検査者;試験器;テスト器;自動テスト機器;自動試験設備;自動検査装置
ng_zh: 测试仪;测试者;试验机;检测仪;自动测验装置;自动化测试仪器
ng_es: ensayador;comprobador;verificador;probeta;equipamiento de prueba automatizado;máquina de ensayo automática
ng_note: 「試験者/测试者/Prüfer/ensayador」は人を指す誤訳。「測試仪/検査器/Testgerät」は汎用計測器（テスター＝回路計）と混同される。Prüfling は被試験物（DUT）で逆の意味。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳） / 「自動テスト機器/設備」は辞書訳で、業界では「テスタ」または略語 ATE で呼ぶ。他言語の「機器/設備」系の直訳も同様に資料に用例なし。「自動検査装置」は inspection と混同する。
source_ref: SEMI E122 — Specification for Tester Equipment Specific Equipment Model (TSEM); M. Burns & G. W. Roberts, An Introduction to Mixed-Signal IC Test and Measurement (Oxford Univ. Press, 2001); SEAJ 半導体製造装置用語集（検査）: テスタ (Automated Test Equipment); M. L. Bushnell & V. D. Agrawal, Essentials of Electronic Testing for Digital, Memory and Mixed-Signal VLSI Circuits (Springer, 2000)

definition_en: A temperature sensor made of two dissimilar metal wires joined at the measuring point, producing a small voltage that depends on the junction temperature. Letter-designated types such as K, J and R are used throughout furnaces, heaters and chucks.
variants_ja: サーモカップル;TC;熱電対センサ
ng_ja: 熱電偶;サーモカプラ;熱電カップル;熱電対偶
ng_zh: 热电对;热电耦合器;热电偶合器
ng_note: couple を「カプラ/耦合器/커플러/Koppler/acoplador」と結合器に誤訳する例がある。「熱電偶」は中国語表記で日本語では「熱電対」。 公開資料（JIS・SEAJ用語集・メーカー資料）に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: IEC 60584-1 — Thermocouples — Part 1: EMF specifications and tolerances; JIS C 1602 — 熱電対

definition_en: Measurement of the out-of-plane deformation of a package or substrate, usually by shadow moire or laser profilometry, at room temperature and through a reflow temperature profile. JEDEC JESD22-B112 defines the method for surface-mount ICs.
variants_ja: ワーページ測定;反り量測定
ng_ja: 歪み測定;変形測定
ng_note: 「歪み／变形／변형／Verformung」は変形全般で、面外の反り（warpage）に限定されない。 公開資料に用例なし（辞書訳）
source_ref: JEDEC JESD22-B112 — Package Warpage Measurement of Surface-Mount Integrated Circuits at Elevated Temperature
